claims.quote: Surpassing the constraints of traditional single-arm parcel induction solutions, [Product]’s innovative design delivers choreographed dual-arm motion which enables industry-leading sustained rates of 2,200-2,300 picks/hour (peak rate: 3,300 picks/hour).
Parcel variability is a major challenge that [Product] overcomes with its innovative [Gripper], which is capable of precisely handling a wide range of sizes and shapes.
By avoiding mispicks and drops, the [Gripper] helps minimize cost per pick, further optimizing system efficiency.
The system avoids picking non-conveyable items, automatically conveying them to a designated path and preventing the robots from wasting cycles handling items that should not be inducted.
Fastest robotic parcel induction on the market
Remote intervention for higher uptime when exceptions arise
[Company] provides the fastest and most reliable parcel handling robotics platform in the world.
Standardizing these systems enables quick deployment and rapid performance gains for high-volume parcel sortation centers and e- commerce fulfillment and distribution centers.
With [Remote software] remote intervention software, [Product] learns from edge cases, all while maximizing your uptime.
